digest_definition: SHA256 of compact JSON [[relative_path,file_sha256],...] sorted by path; excludes publication.json and .nojekyll.
scope: Rendered public drafts and multilingual UI only. Manuscripts/review records/operational scripts excluded. No deployment or learner testing claim.
korean_counts_definition: Schema-valid Korean manuscripts whose rendered HTML matches every learner-facing string; reviewed counts require independent current-source-SHA review records. Unrendered or stale-rendered manuscripts excluded.
